criteria.text: GitNexus compare-to-main impact is captured and contains only expected mobile, gateway, engine, and explicitly linked issue flows.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c1: bounded GitNexus aggregate scope is durably tied to the tested head

criteria.text: Independent whole-branch security and quality review has no unresolved Critical or Important findings.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c2: independent review closure is backed by its immutable report

criteria.text: Full API, Flutter, mobile, contract, browser E2E, accessibility, security, and secret-scan gates pass with exact commands recorded.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c3: every cumulative gate records exact command, head, exit code, and log hash

criteria.text: Real gateway and engine behavior passes through tools/dev/sandbox.sh on API 4098 and engine 4097 while listeners 4001 and 4096 remain untouched.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c4: exact sandbox launcher and listener snapshots prove isolation

criteria.text: A signed development build runs on a physical iPhone and verifies pairing, isolation failures, chat/SSE/PTY, approvals, every Tool, revocation, and background recovery; committed evidence uses only a non-sensitive model label, never a device UDID.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c5: signed physical-device matrix is tied to the tested build without a UDID

criteria.text: A production iOS build and TestFlight submission complete through secure credential tooling without exposing or committing credentials.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c6: production archive and TestFlight submission have source and artifact provenance

criteria.text: Exact evidence is recorded in docs/ai/runs and PR #1165 remains draft, open, unmerged, and updated for human approval.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c7: durable run log agrees with the live draft PR

criteria.text: Async delegation rejects audit/security-locked callers and targets (including stale enabled+locked rows), and a parent locked after dispatch is never woken by a completion.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c8: async delegation rejects locked participants and never wakes a newly locked parent

criteria.text: streamSession/promptAsync exceptions durably mark child/delegation failed, completion claim exceptions release claims/retry, and stale waking claims reconcile after restart exactly once.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c9: dispatch and completion failures persist terminal state and stale claims recover exactly once

criteria.text: Mobile Activity is scoped by req.mobileDevice.userId across sessions, research, schedules, webhooks, cookbook, optimizer and never emits other users' previews/reports.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c10: paired Activity is user-scoped across every source

criteria.text: Paired OpenCode HTTP and SSE never return secrets or filesystem roots/nested directories, with safe operation-specific response shaping/deny.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c11: paired HTTP and SSE shape or deny sensitive upstream fields recursively

criteria.text: Reload/config inspection calls use paired Device auth + opaque project ID, never Basic/direct bypass.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c12: paired reload and inspection stay on Device auth plus opaque project scope

criteria.text: Production/release iOS ATS does not allow arbitrary HTTP, while explicit dev/E2E mode stays local-capable.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c13: production iOS ATS denies arbitrary HTTP while explicit dev and E2E remain local-capable

criteria.text: #1175 release contract proves exact HEAD/evidence/run-log/commands/PR head+draft/checks/build provenance rather than booleans.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c14: release evidence proves one exact tested source head and evidence-only final commits

criteria.text: A selected-project Device token cannot enumerate status or read, mutate, abort, or delete an out-of-scope OpenCode session; session lists/status are filtered and every ID-addressed session/message/part/permission/question/PTY resource is server-side ownership/project validated.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c15: selected-project credentials cannot enumerate or operate on another project session

criteria.text: agent_activity_service Postgres queries select only columns present in postgres_bootstrap, including status_message, project_id, and mcp_role schema parity.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c16: Activity query columns exist in both SQLite and Postgres bootstrap schemas

criteria.text: AGENT_LOCAL auth bypass is structurally confined to loopback: the primary API binds 127.0.0.1, refuses a non-loopback override, and a live IPv4/IPv6 check proves non-loopback interfaces cannot reach it.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c17: AGENT_LOCAL cannot expose the unauthenticated primary API beyond loopback

criteria.text: Pairing never sends a Rhythm Cloud bearer to a QR-selected origin; public health is non-sensitive, the one-time pairing row is the sole user authority, the response is account-bound, and replacement/rollback use only Device credentials.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c18: hostile QR origins never receive cloud credentials and cannot choose pairing identity

criteria.text: Every mobile Tool surface has an explicit tenant policy: user-owned resources are owner-scoped for list/read/update/delete/run, Mac-global execution policy requires a workspace/global administrator, and decision actors are server-derived.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c19: two paired users cannot cross tenant or let staff mutate Mac-global agent policy

criteria.text: Approval listing requires a UI-held Keychain capability whose raw value is never exposed to the API child/model shell, and every decision additionally carries a one-time nonce-bound signature from a non-exportable Secure Enclave/Keychain private key. The child receives only the capability digest and signing public key, the server derives the human actor, and forged, replayed, payload-swapped, status-swapped, AGENT_LOCAL, and Device-token decisions fail closed.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c20: loopback shell and paired-device callers cannot self-approve a human gate

criteria.text: All external or user-authored reads, including message threads and calendar events, are scanned, fenced, and durably tainted fail-closed; every role combining those reads with consequential writes remains payload-bound to real human approval.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c21: church-admin message and calendar prompt injection cannot immediately send outbound content

criteria.text: Production mobile configuration rejects E2E mode, missing or mismatched OAuth settings, and unapproved Cloud origins; its resolved native config and exported bundle contain no test credentials, fake identity, __control transport, or test gateway override.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c22: a production app cannot compile in test mode or with unusable authentication

criteria.text: Google mobile OAuth pins the exact configured Rhythm client and redirect server-side and validates signed ID-token audience, authorized party, nonce, issuer, expiry, and verified email; a code for a caller-selected client is rejected.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c23: caller-chosen Google clients cannot mint Rhythm sessions

criteria.text: The committed iOS production build command is repository-portable, version-pinned, non-interactive, performs authenticated credential/project preflight, and has no private absolute launcher path.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c24: clean-shell production build command is pinned and unattended

criteria.text: Public OpenCode transcript share/unshare is disabled across the gateway contract, generated manifest, provider/service surface, and mobile UI until a private Rhythm-owned sharing design exists.
criteria.test_id: issue-1175-c25: mobile cannot create or expose public OpenCode transcript links
